name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench, one foot flat on the floor and the other leg extended.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower under control and complete all reps before switching legs.
